spans.s:
A तत्-पुरुष compound ending with the word सभा 'court' is neuter, provided that it is preceded by (a word synonymous with) the word राजा or by a word denoting a non-human-being. 

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष-gender

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'excellent with regard thereto' after the word सभा ।

Terms: यत्

Before the word सभा when it is exhibited as Neuter, the first member of the compound gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the last syllable.

Terms: समास end acute-1st-term
